function()
    local units = {"player", "party1", "party2", "party3", "party4"}
    
    for _, unit in ipairs(units) do
        if UnitExists(unit) and UnitIsConnected(unit) and not UnitIsDeadOrGhost(unit) then
            if unit == "player" or UnitIsVisible(unit) then
                
                local hasBuff = false
                local i = 1
                local name, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, spellID = UnitBuff(unit, i)
                
                while name do
                    if spellID == 707349 or spellID == 803661 or spellID == 803665 or spellID == 680315 then
                        hasBuff = true
                    end
                    
                    i = i + 1
                    name, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, spellID = UnitBuff(unit, i)
                end
                
                if not hasBuff then
                    return true 
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return false
end
